prompt_text: Write a Python solution for the HackerRank problem Triplets.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution counts index-based increasing triplets instead of distinct value-based triplets required by the problem.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Fails to remove duplicates before counting, leading to overcounting of identical triplets.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Final accumulation loop using left_smaller[i] * right_greater[i]
